package.name: orma_preload
package.description: liborma_preload.so, loaded with LD_PRELOAD: catches ros_trace_*, rcl_wait, rcl_timer_fini, rclcpp construction functions, flux_trace_*, orma_span markers and, on request, CUDA driver and DDS write calls, and writes orma's shared memory file. Also the static interception library orma_intercept that the LTTng backend links.
